proposal.rationale: The requested revision is supportable as a complete future graph with the reviewed primitives and exact bindings already supplied. I preserved the reviewed next identity and version from the decision declaration: campaign_id polymer-screening-mvp, revision 4, schema_version 4, profile deterministic-v3, and the exact three pinned context records. The graph keeps the four supported screening invocations unchanged in structure and tool binding: two Hansen solvency runs for the two supplied parameter artifacts and two Arrhenius viscosity runs for the two supplied parameter artifacts, all feeding a single finish node that exports the retained campaign context plus all four results. The scientific question is the same screening question as the selected research record: what the parallel solvency and temperature-adjusted viscosity screens show for the supplied synthetic polymer parameter sets. The remaining synthesis/laboratory-confirmation gap is recorded only as unresolved advisory context, because it is outside this screening-only executable campaign and does not require inventing a synthesis capability.
